title: Reverse-Engineering the AI Buyer — Aliisa Rosenthal, Acrew Capital
talk_summary: A go-to-market talk from an ex-OpenAI sales leader about building self-serve before hiring salespeople, avoiding pilots, and pricing/security automation. It is about selling AI products to enterprise buyers, not about building or operating AI agent systems.

takeaways.technique: Automate the pipeline before adding humans at bottlenecks
takeaways.what_they_do: They advise founders to build the automated machine first, find where it breaks, then add humans only at those bottlenecks rather than hiring a team and bolting on automation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: build the machine first before you build the team. Figure out what you can automate. Figure out where the bottlenecks are

takeaways.technique: Self-serve default with opt-out instead of heavy gated pilots
takeaways.what_they_do: They argue against resource-heavy POCs, preferring self-serve access plus a 90-day opt-out clause so the burden of validation shifts to the customer.
takeaways.evidence_quote: sign a contract, you have 90 days to opt out if it doesn't meet your needs
